S0428.src: Missale O.P. (1939), pp. 420-421 and calendar: 'S. Pauli a Cruce Conf. Memoria.' The Mass of 28 Apr. is B. Ludovici M. Grignion de Montfort, 'Officium Os justi, ut in Comm. Conf. non Pont., pag. 23*, cum Evang. Designavit, pag. 25*', with the prayers De S. Paulo a Cruce as a commemoration; G28 (28 Apr.): Missa Os justi, pag. 42*. The 1959 chants (incl. St Peter Martyr's Alleluia and Communio) were wrong.
S0428.title: 28 Apr. — S. Pauli a Cruce, C. (Memoria; Missa Os justi)
S0428.en: Apr 28 — St Paul of the Cross (Memoria; Mass Os justi)
S0428.note: S. Pauli a Cruce: Memoria (Missale O.P. 1939, pp. 420-421). The Mass of the day is that of B. Louis Grignion de Montfort, Os justi, de Communi Conf. non Pont. (Missal p. 23*, Gospel Designavit p. 25*; Graduale O.P. 1928, 42*), with the prayers of St Paul of the Cross as a commemoration.
